# Files whose edits do not re-run the merge gate (read by .github/scripts/pr_gate.sh).
# A push that changes only these files (added/modified) reuses the result of the latest tested commit.
# One repo-relative file path per line (no directories or globs); '#' starts a comment.
# Read from the PR's base branch, so a PR cannot widen its own list.
